plugins.name: theme-examples
plugins.description: Twenty animated backdrops, light and dark: a lagoon, a night reef, a koi pond, halftone sunrises, a departure board, a braille starfield and more. Pick one with /custom-theme.
plugins.author: Anthropic
plugins.title: Theme Examples (all 20 scenes)

looks.name: Honu Lagoon
looks.description: A live ASCII lagoon from above: a tile turtle swims by a sand island.

looks.name: Koi Mosaic
looks.description: A tiled koi pond from above: two koi, lily pads, slow ripples.

looks.name: Halftone Dawn
looks.description: A two-ink riso sunrise: halftone dots that breathe outward.

looks.name: Halftone Dusk
looks.description: The riso sunrise on night-blue stock: an ember sun in breathing dots.

looks.name: Plotter Tide
looks.description: Pen-plotter tide lines drawing themselves on warm paper.

looks.name: Plotter Tide, Night
looks.description: The plotter's tide chart in pale ink on blue-black night paper.

looks.name: Dither Dunes
looks.description: One-bit dunes on sand paper, shaded in dots, under a terracotta sun.

looks.name: Dither Dunes Night
looks.description: The same dunes after dark: pale dots on umber, an ember sun.

looks.name: Paper Garden
looks.description: Cut-paper leaves at the edges of a warm white sheet, one coral bloom.

looks.name: Paper Garden, Kraft
looks.description: Cut-paper leaves at the edges of dark kraft paper, one coral bloom.

looks.name: Night Reef
looks.description: The lagoon after dark: a turtle and a ray that glow as they swim.

looks.name: Snow Pines
looks.description: An ASCII pine forest at dusk, snow drifting down through the trees.

looks.name: Braille Stars
looks.description: A slow night sky drawn dot by dot on a braille grid.

looks.name: Block Clouds
looks.description: Night clouds built from blocks on a teletext grid, drifting in.

looks.name: Vector Range
looks.description: Phosphor mountains on black; an amber beam keeps retracing them.

looks.name: Departure Board
looks.description: An amber LED board re-lettering itself, row by row.

looks.name: Blueprint
looks.description: A cyanotype sheet; a comet goes round its plotted orbit in the corner.

looks.name: Deep Water
looks.description: Light falling through deep water, and one quiet turtle.

looks.name: Aurora
looks.description: Northern lights swaying over a dark ridge.

looks.name: Ember
looks.description: A warm glow in the corners and a few embers rising.
